params.caption: 🎮 GTA 6 scores 99 on Metacritic — tied for the highest-rated game ever The GTA 6 review embargo has lifted and the game sits at 99 on Metacritic, level with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as the best-scored game of all time. VGC calls it "the game of the generation", GamesRadar+ praises an open world of "astonishing scale, scope, and quality", and Eurogamer has published its full review. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 14:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: VGC · GamesRadar+ · VGC review · GamesRadar+ review · Eurogamer review 👥 @RockstarGames · @PlayStation · @Xbox 🏆 React if it deserves the 99 · 💬 Greatest game ever, or too soon? #GTA6 #Rockstar #Metacritic #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
